_description: Per-post instructions for the upgrade desk, from the 2026-11-20 search-results gap analysis and the cannibalization review. seo_queue.py prints the note for the post it picks; apply it, verify every fact and number against a source, then delete the entry in the same commit.

US release date in the first sentence (verify: unveiled Jul 27, 2004; US Nov 16, 2004)
